message.content: ```python import pytest from tornado.escape import linkify, _URL_RE, xhtml_escape, to_unicode def test_linkify_basic_url(): """Linkify a simple http URL and verify the output.""" text = "Visit http://example.com for more info." result = linkify(text) # The URL should be wrapped in an tag with the same href and text. assert 'http://example.com' in result # The surrounding text should remain unchanged. assert result.startswith("Visit ") assert result.endswith(" for more info.") def test_linkify_shorten_long_url(): """When shorten=True, long URLs are truncated and a title attribute is added.""" long_url = "http://example.com/this/is/a/very/long/path/that/should/be/shortened" text = f"Check {long_url} now." result = linkify(text, shorten=True) # The link text should be shorter than the original URL. assert long_url not in result # The href should still contain the full URL. assert f'href="{long_url}"' in result # The title attribute should be present with the full URL. assert f'title="{long_url}"' in result # The link text should end with '...' indicating truncation. assert result.split('>')[1].endswith("...<") or result.split('>')[1].endswith("...<") # noqa: E501 def test_linkify_bytes_input_and_protocol_requirement(): """Linkify should accept bytes and respect require_protocol.""" # Bytes input should be decoded to str internally. bytes_text = b"Visit www.example.com or http://example.com" result = linkify(bytes_text, require_protocol=True) # URLs without protocol should not be linkified when require_protocol=True. assert 'www.example.com' in result assert 'http://example.com' in result ```
